name: content-type-manager-cell
description: List available content types with metadata. Ephemeral utility cell that provides content type discovery for building type-aware asset browsers and filters.

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral utility (not persisted)

_discovery.describe: Administrative utility for managing ContentType definitions. Allows creation, editing, and validation of content type schemas (MIME types, expected fragments, render hints, storage policies). Provides schema designer with JSON validation and documentation generation. Essential for extending the content system with new asset types. Instant operations for schema management. Requires admin permissions.
use_cases: Define new content types for custom assets
Configure storage policies and render hints
